about.title: About
about.description: Diego Mancassola is a Technical Solution Architect at PA Expertise - Alveo group, working on Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations architecture, integrations and AI.
about.bio: Technical Solution Architect at PA Expertise - Alveo group, based in Vicenza, Italy. I work on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: architecture, integrations with Azure API Management and Azure Functions, functional and technical analysis. Lately I build tools where AI does the reading and the judging, and code does the plumbing.
about.nameStory: dasdynamics reads “D as Dynamics”. The D is also mine: the monogram is a small D inside a larger one.
about.history: From 2014 to 2024 I kept Dynamics AX Notes on Blogger. Those notes now live in the archive here, each with a verdict for D365FO today. New articles are published on this site first.
